fields.Name: T068 - PS Model-Dev-Agent Copilot
fields.Description: Opens the Predictive Studio app once, then verifies the two Model Development Agent docked copilot entry points (Predictions '+ New prediction' panel and the Studio door 'Ask the Model Dev Agent' panel) via checkpoints. Consolidates old T151, T163.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the Predictive Studio application using the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (scroll if needed). Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait for content rather than navigating away. Then walk these sections IN ORDER, and as you arrive at each one set "checkpointReached" to the exact checkpoint name shown: (1) new-prediction-copilot — on the 'Predictions' door, click the '+ New prediction' button (or 'Build your first prediction' in the empty state) and confirm a docked co-pilot chat panel slides in on the right, titled 'New prediction', with a Model Development Agent conversation area and a message composer (you do NOT need to send a message); (2) studio-ask-agent-copilot — open the 'Studio' door on the 'Overview' section and click the 'Ask the Model Dev Agent' hero button (or the 'Ask the agent' entry-path card), then confirm a docked co-pilot chat panel opens on the right titled 'Model Dev Agent' with a conversation area ready for input. Keep going until every section has been visited.

checkpoints.name: new-prediction-copilot
checkpoints.instruction: open the '+ New prediction' docked copilot on the Predictions door
visualCriteria: Clicking '+ New prediction' opens a docked chat panel titled 'New prediction' on the right side containing a conversation/message input area for the Model Development Agent

checkpoints.name: studio-ask-agent-copilot
checkpoints.instruction: open the Studio door 'Ask the Model Dev Agent' docked copilot
visualCriteria: Clicking 'Ask the Model Dev Agent' on the Studio door opens a docked chat panel titled 'Model Dev Agent' on the right of the Studio workbench with a conversation/message area
